newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB wins $100 mln Russian order.
newsitem.headline: ABB wins $100 mln Russian order.

text.p: Swedish-Swiss engineering group ABB said its ABB Lummus Global unit had won an order worth more than $100 million to modernise a refinery for Russia's JSC Nizhnekamskneftekhim (NKNK).

The order is for NKNK's complex in Nizhnekamsk, 1,200 km east of Moscow in the republic of Tatarstan. NKNK produces refined petroleum products, chemicals and petrochemicals as well as finished consumer products, ABB said in a statement.
The project is to reduce the sulphur content of its kerosene and gas oil products in line with environmental standards in Russia and its export markets in Europe, North America and Asia.
The project will be financed in part through a loan guarantee from the U.S. Export-Import Bank under the Oil and Gas Framework agreement between Russia and the United States.
